headline: Capcom is preparing for a ‘future where we create games together with AI’
summary: Capcom is actively exploring AI integration into its game development process. Programmer Satoshi Ishida detailed the REX Project at the Capcom Open Conference. The studio aims to evolve its RE Engine to facilitate AI collaboration.

headline: The best early October Prime Day deals happening now
summary: Amazon has begun early discounts for its Prime Big Deal Day event. Sales include various Amazon hardware and popular products. The official October Prime Day starts on October 6th and runs through the 8th.

headline: Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava thinks AI emails are killing conversations
summary: Kakul Srivastava, CEO of sample platform Splice, believes AI-generated emails are detrimental to genuine conversations. Splice's samples are widely used in hit music. Srivastava has a background in executive roles before leading Splice.

headline: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
summary: David Robinson, a former OpenAI safety report writer, has resigned from his position. He is now publicly expressing concerns about AI dangers in an editorial for The Atlantic. Robinson previously authored crucial safety reports for major OpenAI model releases.

headline: Gears of War: E-Day Devs 'Proud to Be One of Xbox's Main Titles' Amid Newfound Focus on Exclusivity
summary: The Coalition, developers of Gears of War: E-Day, express pride in their game's status as a key Xbox title. Microsoft is reportedly increasing its focus on exclusive games. Gears of War: E-Day is positioned as a significant release for the platform.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter, Shuten Order, MLB The Show 26, and More
summary: Discover the top gaming deals available today. Featured discounts include Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter and MLB The Show 26. Explore various offers on popular game titles.

headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Video Reveals Major Change That Could End Wallhacks for Good
summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is introducing a significant new feature. This change aims to permanently combat wallhacks, a persistent issue in the series. Activision is seeking to eliminate cheating methods for a fairer experience.

headline: 'I Did My Best' — Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Director Responds to Fans Asking for Full Disc Version
summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director Naoki Hamaguchi addressed fan requests for a full disc release. He stated he made efforts to advocate for a physical version. Hamaguchi acknowledged the industry's shift towards a "disc-less" future for media.

headline: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says
summary: A Flydubai co-pilot allegedly attacked the captain with an axe during a flight. The incident reportedly occurred on an Israel-bound jet. UAE officials identified the accused as Hamam al-Hammami.

headline: UK-Iranian dual national arrested over RAF Fairford released on bail
summary: A 25-year-old UK-Iranian dual national was arrested in Westminster. The arrest was in connection to an incident at RAF Fairford. The individual has since been released on bail.

headline: Tennessee prison chief to resign after Christa Pike's failed execution
summary: Tennessee's prison chief is set to resign following a failed execution attempt. Inmate Christa Pike survived two lethal injections and is in critical condition. Her lawyers argue the failure signifies systemic issues, not just an individual error.

headline: Kemi Badenoch has cemented her image. Now she wants to put her party back on the big stage
summary: Kemi Badenoch is expected to deliver a speech at the Conservative party's annual conference. She plans to outline a return to core conservative principles. Badenoch aims to elevate her party's prominence on the national stage.
